reader_summary.overview: A word of mouth is how this podcast grows. Hello and welcome, everybody, to another. episode of the GetStacked investment podcast. Today, Corey and I had the privilege of speaking with Jonathan Glidden. He is the chief investment officer of the Delta Airlines pension plan.

key_points.text: And since joining the Delta pension plan in 2011.
key_points.evidence_quote: And since joining the Delta pension plan in 2011, John has been absolutely instrumental in transforming the company's pension plan from a 38% funded status to over 100% funded status today.

key_points.text: And John actually attributes a large part of his success in this turnaround to his targeted implementation of portable alpha strategies.
key_points.evidence_quote: And John actually attributes a large part of his success in this turnaround to his targeted implementation of portable alpha strategies.

key_points.text: And so in this conversation, we go through his industry background, how he thinks about the proper portable alpha implementation process.
key_points.evidence_quote: And so in this conversation, we go through his industry background, how he thinks about the proper portable alpha implementation process, including what not to do.

key_points.text: And also some amazing war stories of 2008, 2020 that I think we could all gather lessons from.

thesis: The podcast introduces Jonathan Glidden, the CIO of the Delta Airlines pension plan, who transformed the plan's funded status from 38% to over 100% through the targeted implementation of portable alpha strategies. Glidden argues that many portfolios are dominated by the equity factor with traditional managers canceling each other out, so he builds better beta portfolios and seeks one to two percent of alpha on top of that.
